questions.stem: Look at the timetable. The train ____ (leave) at 8:00.

options.distractor: 时刻表上的时间用一般现在时

questions.explanation: 时刻表上写好的时间，用一般现在时 leaves。

questions.stem: I ____ (go) to the zoo with my parents this Sunday. It's all planned.

options.distractor: 已经安排好的事，用进行时表将来

questions.explanation: 已经计划妥当的近期安排，用 am going。

questions.stem: — When ____ the film ____ (start)? — At 7:30. Let me check the timetable.

options.distractor: 查时刻表问的是固定场次，用一般现在时
the film 是三单，助动词用 does

questions.explanation: 看时刻表问的场次时间，用一般现在时 does…start。

questions.stem: He ____ (come) to see me this evening. We've arranged it.

options.distractor: 已经约好的安排，用进行时表将来

questions.explanation: come 是位移动词，已经约好的事用 is coming 表将来。

options.text: I'm visiting my aunt this weekend.

questions.explanation: “快点，车来了”是马上要发生的事，应用 The bus is coming。

questions.stem: My father ____ (leave) for Guangzhou tomorrow morning. His ticket is ready.

options.distractor: 这里不是时刻表，而是票已买好的安排

questions.explanation: 票已准备好，是安排好的近期动作，用 is leaving 表将来（leaves 只在时刻表语境下才对）。

options.distractor: 固定营业时间属于日程，用一般现在时

questions.explanation: 每天固定的营业时间属于日程表性质，用一般现在时 opens。

questions.stem: My uncle ____ (arrive) here tonight. His train ticket is ready.

options.distractor: 票已买好是安排妥当的事，用进行时表将来

questions.explanation: 票已准备好，arrive 是位移动词，用 is arriving 表将来。

questions.stem: The first class ____ (begin) at 8:00. Don't be late.

options.distractor: 课程表上的固定时间用一般现在时

questions.explanation: 课表上写好的上课时间，用一般现在时 begins。

questions.stem: — Why are you in such a hurry? — I ____ (meet) Mr Li at the station at 3:00. It's arranged.

options.distractor: 已经约好的安排，用进行时表将来
主语是 I，且这里表已安排的将来

questions.explanation: 已经约好、马上要做的安排，用 am meeting 表将来。

options.text: We are moving to a new house next week.
The plane is taking off at 10:00.

questions.explanation: 时刻表上的起飞时间是固定的，应改为 The plane takes off at 10:00。

options.text: The concert starts at 7:30. Don't be late.
They are getting married next month.
I am leaving for Beijing. My ticket is booked.
The film is starting at 8:00 every night.

questions.explanation: “每晚八点”是固定场次，属于日程表，应改为 The film starts at 8:00 every night。
